'''Ulfric Longbeard''' is an undead [[Fremennik]] sailor. His vessel was one of several that transported treasure. However, some of the treasure was cursed, causing the ships to crash. Ulfric's ship crashed into a [[Brine Rat Cavern|cavern]], and he and his [[Skeleton fremennik|crew]] perished there.

[[Sven the Helmsman]], one of Ulfric's crew, drew a [[Sven's last map|map]], which eventually made its way to his grandson [[Olaf Hradson]]. Olaf failed to find the treasure and, believing the map to be cursed, gave it to an adventurer who helped him. The adventurer found the cavern and located the treasure. When they tried to take it, Ulfric rose from the dead to defend it.

He acts as the final [[boss]] during [[Olaf's Quest]]. He is fairly easy to defeat due to his low and inaccurate hits. [[Protect from Melee]] can be used to reduce the damage from his attacks, or he can be safespotted by using his gravestone as a barrier.
